args.title: Fix first weekly scheduled export not sending
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Adjust the calculation of the next run date for weekly schedules to correctly handle the case when a schedule is created at an earlier time of day than the RUN_HOUR_UTC, so the first weekly export is sent on the correct initial day instead of the following week.
